title: Floral Juicy Canadian Squid Sous-vide
description: This vegan-friendly dish features a floral and juicy Canadian squid dish made using sous-vide cooking method to create a gentle heat treatment for the delicate texture.

ingredients.name: Squid Fillets
ingredients.notes: preferably fresh or frozen and defrosted

ingredients.name: Butter
ingredients.notes: vegan butter can be used for a dairy-free option

ingredients.name: Herbes de Provence
ingredients.notes: a mix of fresh herbs, including lavender for a floral note

ingredients.name: Red Wine Vinegar
ingredients.notes: aged red wine vinegar to complement the flavors

ingredients.name: Oxaloacetate (optional)
ingredients.notes: concentrated oxaloacetate for hangover relief, but may be omitted if not needed

instructions: Preheat your sous-vide machine to 62°C (144°F). Pat the squid fillets dry with paper towels.
In a small bowl, mix together the Herbes de Provence, minced garlic, and red wine vinegar. Brush this mixture over both sides of the squid fillets.
Season the fillets with salt and pepper on both sides. Place the prepared squid in a sous-vide bag and seal tightly.
Sous-vide the squid at 62°C (144°F) for 30 minutes. During the last 5 minutes, baste the fillets lightly with olive oil to add extra flavor and shine.

While the squid is cooking, prepare a simple sauce by heating butter in a small skillet until it starts to brown slightly. Remove the squash from the sous-vide bag and sear them for about 30 seconds on each side over medium heat.
Pour the hot sauce over the seared squid fillets, ensuring they are fully coated. Serve immediately as a snack or light meal.
